heroSummary: Garland ISD classes begin Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 15–19. Students return October 20 after Fall Break and January 5 after Winter Break because October 19 and January 4 are student holidays and staff-development days.
calendarNotes: The official calendar lists 175 instructional days. Early dismissal is scheduled for December 18 and May 27. Garland ISD’s web calendar and printable calendar describe the May 27 dismissal differently, so families should confirm final dismissal details with their campus.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Garland ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of class is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Garland ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: How long is Garland ISD Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a student holiday and staff-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Garland ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of class is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is early dismissal in Garland ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: The printable 2026–27 calendar lists 1:25 p.m. for full-day Pre-K and elementary, 2:05 p.m. for middle school, and 12:40 p.m. for high school. The district web calendar describes May 27 differently, so families should confirm final dismissal details with their campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Garland ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Open the official Garland ISD PDF from this page or download the MySchoolDates .ics file for a one-time import into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
content: School starts one day earlier: August 10 instead of August 11.
Spring Break shifts one day earlier: March 15–19, 2027, instead of March 16–20, 2026.
The school year ends five calendar days later: May 27 instead of May 22.

sourceReviewSummary: Sources checked include Garland ISD’s school-year calendar page and current 2026–27 academic calendar PDF. The two official sources describe May 27 early dismissal differently; the note on this page preserves that distinction.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was checked for school-year boundaries, break ranges, grading dates, staff-development ranges, student holidays, and early-dismissal times.
The first semester has 82 instructional days and the second semester has 93, for 175 total instructional days.
The PDF lists July 1–3, July 30–31, and August 3–7 as ranges; this page preserves those ranges rather than presenting only their start dates.
Campus-specific testing, athletics, performances, ceremonies, and emergency changes are outside this districtwide calendar.
